selected.where: range(n+1) iterates split points for string a
selected.how: range excludes stop, so i=n is visited; however, if the spec requires checking concatenation orders (a+b and b+a) only, this loop checks all interleavings, potentially missing the specific 'b+a' case if logic assumes only prefix splits.
selected.what: Input [')', '('] returns 'No' because the loop only checks a[:i]+b+a[i:], missing the b+a case which is '()'.
